\usetikzlibrary{positioning}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.pathreplacing}
\definecolor{black}{HTML}{000000}
\tikzset{
    > = stealth,
    every node/.append style = {
        draw = none
    },
    every edge/.append style = {
        arrows = ->,
        fill = none
    },
    hidden/.style = {
        draw = black,
        shape = circle,
        inner sep = 1pt
    }
}
\tikz{

    \node (y1) at (1,4) {$Y_1$};

    
    \node[hidden] (y1a) at (0,3) {$Y_{1A}$};
    \node[hidden] (y1b) at (2,3) {$Y_{1B}$};

    
    \node (x1) at (1,0) {$X_1$};
    
    
    \node (z1) at (1,2) {$Z_{1}$};
    
    \node[hidden] (x1a) at (0,1) {$X_{1A}$};
    \node[hidden] (x1b) at (2,1) {$X_{1B}$};

    % latent -> obs
       % X->X%
    \draw[->, double] (x1a) to (x1);
    \draw[->, double] (x1b) to (x1);

    \draw[->, double] (y1a) to (y1);
    \draw[->, double] (y1b) to (y1);

    % Y->Y%
    \path (y1a) edge (y1b);

   % X->X%
    \path (x1a) edge (x1b);

       % X->Y%
    \path[bend right=340] (x1a) edge (y1b);

       % Y->X%
    \path (y1a)[bend right=20] edge (x1b);

    
    \path (x1a) edge (z1);
    \path (y1a) edge (z1);
    \path (z1) edge (x1b);
    \path (z1) edge (y1b);

    

  }
